native.primitives: Root DESIGN.md mobile-* colors, typography, rounded and components; native-* spacing. Existing unprefixed web tokens retain their scope.
native.units: React Native numeric logical units; DESIGN.md uses pixel strings for portable tooling. Browser translations render CSS pixels.
native.appearance: System/light/dark preference selects theme roles. Exact pack photos keep white image surfaces; the temporary basket mark follows tint/on-tint.
native.type: Platform system fonts, fontFamily unset. Scaling enabled. English/Urdu text uses alignment and writingDirection; full layout mirroring is not claimed.
native.icons: Mapped iOS SF Symbols and Android Material Community icons, Ionicons fallback. Browser implementation is separate.
native.elevation: Flat bordered cards and tonal surfaces; no native shared shadow tokens.
native.storage: Native SecureStore for receipt keys, opt-in addresses and pending customer details; device-local basket, favourites, language, appearance, named lists, recent searches/viewed products and history. Browser private fields use sessionStorage.

review.retryFixes: Both material retry fixes resolved: only explicit order validation/stock-price rejection releases an attempt; uncertain responses preserve key and payload.
checks: Browser captures: home, categories, product, basket, Urdu

native.tokenAdvisories: Wrapper detector advisories #e5ebe7, #11231c, #f7f9f6 belong to the preview/native extension, not a replacement web palette.
native.tonalRamps: New native ramps are synthesized display metadata from source hex hue/chroma; runtime uses only the documented exact light/dark role values.

narrative.overview: The approved Everyday Market native refinement carries the temporary Daily Basket basket mark, teal role colors and real grocery photography into Expo/React Native. Native tokens retain mobile- names; unrelated web tokens retain their scope.
dos: Use the temporary Daily Basket wordmark and simple basket mark.
Preserve real pack photography and catalog identities.
Use native role colors and system typography.
Keep guest checkout and server-authoritative totals explicit.
donts: Do not restore supplier branding as the customer identity.
Do not represent browser captures or JS exports as native-device QA or signed installations.
Do not introduce customer push, account syncing or live rider tracking claims.

narrative.overview:
Daily Basket is a temporary customer identity: a simple teal basket icon beside a readable wordmark. The user clarified that Askari supplies inventory and revoked its customer-facing name/logo. Historical supplier artwork remains source provenance; future work must follow the customer identity shown in `components/StoreLogo.tsx` and `mobile/src/ui.tsx`. The final name is pending.

The established website uses white shelves, pale aqua fields, teal controls and Poppins typography. The approved Everyday Market native refinement carries the same grocery clarity through compact system typography, photographic browsing and exact pack identity. Native tokens use `mobile-` names and `native-` spacing; unrelated incumbent web tokens retain their scope. The preview frame belongs only to the labelled browser wrapper.
keyCharacteristics: Real pack photographs and visible pack sizes.
Teal actions, quiet bordered surfaces and explicit stock states.
A compact basket wordmark without supplier branding.
Native system typography and readable light/dark role colors.
Clear quantity, delivery-progress and server-confirmed order feedback.

rules.name: The Real Shelf Rule
rules.body: Display imported selling prices and actual stock. No invented markup, discount, rating or availability may be added to customer screens.

rules.name: The Familiar Name Rule
rules.body: Keep real package names, brands and variants in ordinary case; package photography carries their own lettering.

rules.name: The Shelf Border Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal surfaces to separate grocery information; keep product photography clear of decorative depth.

dos: **Do** use Daily Basket as a temporary customer wordmark and simple basket mark until the final name is confirmed.
**Do** preserve exact pack photography, real brand/variant labels, imported prices and explicit stock states.
**Do** scope native light/dark roles to the app and its identified preview/privacy wrappers.
**Do** keep guest checkout, current-stock list/reorder checks and server-confirmed totals clear.
**Do** retain supplier provenance, real contacts, 5 km PGECHS dispatch coverage, COD rules, compatible storage namespaces and authenticated staff tools.
donts: **Don't** restore Askari's name or supplier-logo artwork as the customer-facing identity.
**Don't** import reference-store names, logos, promotions or unrelated departments.
**Don't** invent selling prices, discounts, rewards, live tracking or payment confirmation.
**Don't** present browser captures or JavaScript exports as native-device QA, signed installations or app-store publication.
**Don't** finalize the temporary name or production identifiers without the owner's confirmation before the first production signing/EAS project.
